tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground on every page. Never pure white for the page itself: grey reads as paper, white reads as screen.

tokens.name: paper-lift
tokens.usage: Cards, quote tiles, panels and pinned notes sitting on `paper`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, headings and every drawn line, including the tendril stem. 16.3:1 on `paper`, 18.6:1 on `paper-lift`. Also the focus ring.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, metadata, marginalia in Shantell. 4.9:1 on `paper`, 5.6:1 on `paper-lift`, 4.6:1 on the highlighter. Never on `ink`.

tokens.name: spot
tokens.usage: Pink. Identity and action: the logo, link underlines, button fills, the one bud on a tendril. Never text (2.8:1 on `paper`). Text on a pink fill uses `on-spot`.

tokens.name: spot-soft
tokens.usage: Light pink. The J of the KJ mark, the second petal colour in brush flowers, and Shantell signoffs on `garden-deep`. Never text on `paper`.

tokens.name: on-spot
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `spot` fill, for example a button label. 5.9:1.

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: Green for text and UI. Things that grow, only: tendril leaves, topic and map tags, planted and tended dates. Never buttons or links. 4.7:1 on `paper`. Painted greenery uses the `garden-*` tokens instead.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Yellow. Attention and state: the recently-tended dot, display type on `ink` slabs (14.8:1). Never text on `paper` (1.1:1). Inside illustrations only as `bud`, the centre of a brush flower.

tokens.name: sun-wash
tokens.usage: Highlighter behind `ink` text (15:1 on the result). One highlight per note or quote.

tokens.name: spot-wash
tokens.usage: Rare pink tint for a single tile or illustration fill. Never behind body copy.

tokens.name: moss-tape
tokens.usage: Tape strips on pinned paper.

tokens.name: ink-hair
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on cards, tiles and dividers between rows.

tokens.name: paper-press
tokens.usage: The hard offset shadow under paper objects. Shadow colour only, never a fill.

tokens.name: sky-high
tokens.usage: Scene only. Top band of the sky on Home, the map and the inner-page sky strip. Ink on it is 9.6:1.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Scene only. Middle sky band, the main field behind the Home hero. Ink 11.4:1.

tokens.name: sky-low
tokens.usage: Scene only. Lowest sky band, nearest the cloud bank.

tokens.name: cloud-cream
tokens.usage: Scene only. The body of every cloud.

tokens.name: cloud-peach
tokens.usage: Scene only. Warm underside of a cloud, painted one step below the cream.

tokens.name: cloud-shade
tokens.usage: Scene only. Cool underside of a cloud and the first row of the cloud bank.

tokens.name: garden-teal
tokens.usage: Scene only. Deepest shadow in painted greenery: the inside of the arch, the base of a bush.

tokens.name: garden-green
tokens.usage: Scene only. The main body of painted leaves.

tokens.name: garden-lime
tokens.usage: Scene only. Leaves catching light, top and left of every shape.

tokens.name: garden-spring
tokens.usage: Scene only. The brightest leaf dabs, used sparingly on top.

tokens.name: garden-rim
tokens.usage: Scene only. The pale outline around a canopy, from the looking-up-at-trees reference.

tokens.name: garden-deep
tokens.usage: The footer ground on every page. `paper` text on it is 7.7:1, `spot-soft` 4.6:1.

tokens.name: lawn
tokens.usage: Scene only. The lawn in the garden footer and the ground of the map. Also the hole colour for tags hung on the map.

tokens.name: path
tokens.usage: Scene only. Garden paths, the way through the arch.

tokens.name: path-edge
tokens.usage: Scene only. The edge of a path and stepping stones.

tokens.name: bud
tokens.usage: Scene only. The centre of a brush flower, with three dark seed dots.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Page titles on Home and section index pages. Add SOFT 60, WONK 1.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Note and piece titles. SOFT 60, WONK 1.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings inside a page. SOFT 48, WONK 1.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Card titles, small headings. SOFT 30, WONK 0.

styles.name: translit
styles.usage: Transliteration on the Quotes page only.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I keep a garden here instead of a feed.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, nav, topic tags. Sentence case, never all caps.

styles.name: note
styles.sample: still not sure if this is a complaint or a design brief
styles.usage: Kavya's own voice only: asides, reflections, signoffs. Rotate -1.5deg to 0.

styles.name: note-s
styles.usage: Small marginalia and kickers above headings.

styles.name: deva
styles.usage: Original-script quotes. Load on the Quotes page only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap inside a tag.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between tags, chips and small controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between bento tiles.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum page side gutter; tight card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card and tile padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Panel padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default for every paper object: cards, tiles, slabs, polaroids. Paper has square corners.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Topic tags.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Round things only: the recency dot, the vinyl record.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: Hard offset shadow under resting paper. No blur, ever.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hover state for clickable paper, paired with a 2px nudge up-left.

tokens.name: tilt-s
tokens.usage: Barely there. Opened quote cards, marginalia blocks.

tokens.name: tilt-m
tokens.usage: Pinned notes and handwriting kickers.

tokens.name: tilt-max
tokens.usage: The limit in either direction. Past this, paper looks dropped rather than placed.

tokens.name: measure-text
tokens.usage: Max width of running body text.

tokens.name: measure-page
tokens.usage: Max width of the page container on inner pages. Home and the map use 66rem and 74rem so the scene has room.
